parts.text: Can you check the operational status and warranty coverage of my company machine, LAPTOP-002?
Device LAPTOP-002 is a ThinkPad T14 with operational status 'Needs Repair' and its warranty is 'Expired'.
Please check the warranty status of device INVALID_ID_NO_HYPHEN.
Please provide a valid corporate asset tag in '<TYPE>-<NUMBER>' format, such as 'LAPTOP-002' or 'MACBOOK-104'.
What is our enterprise policy when a ThinkPad laptop needs repair and its warranty has expired?

When a device needs repair and its warranty is expired, do not dispatch vendor warranty repair; log a HIGH severity support ticket and initiate an emergency hardware replacement request subject to human approval.
My device LAPTOP-002 is broken and out of warranty. Please order an emergency replacement MacBook Pro 16 M4 for user tez because my primary engineering workstation will not boot.
The emergency hardware replacement requisition has been staged and requires human supervisor confirmation before fulfillment.
